_engine.provenance: Recorded by sverrejb/docxide-pdf's page-metrics binary over mutool 1.28.4 (2026-09-05). Re-frozen on MuPDF 1.29.0 (PyMuPDF 1.28.0), the engine page_metrics.py drives: only file_100_file_101_redline.text_boundary moved (0.5 = 95/190 -> 105/191) because 1.29 splits one equation line on the LibreOffice render's page 6 that 1.28.4 keeps whole. The ported algorithm over mutool 1.28.4 stext output reproduces 95/190 exactly. SSIM is not ported (pagefair-v2 carries it).
